title: 鸣鹤园 Minghe Yuan
subtitle: a neighbouring imperial or princely garden · outside the walls · confidence B, assumed

model.line: Massing only, not a reconstruction: 63 plain blocks (walls, houses, halls), a tinted patch of ground. Its houses, rows and halls are generated to the kind of place, not drawn from a plan of it: assumed (C). The switch `around=0` hides everything outside the walls.

questions.title: 近春园, 淑春园 and 鸣鹤园 in 1860

searched: No picture of it found in the catalogues searched for the surroundings.

facts.label: What it was
facts.value: a neighbouring imperial or princely garden outside the garden walls

facts.label: In 1860
facts.value: held by 惠亲王 绵愉 (from 1834) (S1215; S1216); burned 1860, the 翼然亭 the only survivor (S1217); PKU's own garden page blames 徐世昌's demolitions (S1216): disagreement

facts.label: Where
facts.value: C: west of 镜春园 (镜春园西路, osm way 1101010417), the 赛克勒 museum and 红湖 area; its extent, a circle of 110 m, is assumed

facts.label: Note
facts.value: Before 1832 仪亲王永璇. 燕京大学 bought it about 1928.
